categories.main_business_segments: Long Young Electronic (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electromagnetic shielding materials, insulation materials, thermal management materials, and copper foil materials. Its products mainly serve the 3C consumer electronics sector (notebooks, tablets, wearable devices) and the new energy vehicle industry (automotive electronics such as central control, radar, and smart cockpits). The company is expanding its copper foil product line targeting lithium batteries, printed circuit boards (PCB), and flexible printed circuits (FPC).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including roll-to-roll vacuum magnetron sputtering, composite coating, flexible shielding materials, continuous strip full-direction conductive sponge preparation, high-speed precision forming, non-mold die-cutting, and automated waste removal. It also develops advanced copper foil materials using vacuum deposition and electroplating techniques, including lithium battery composite copper foil and high-frequency copper foil for AI applications. Production combines in-house manufacturing with outsourced processes like die-cutting and lamination to meet capacity demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global consumer electronics brands such as Apple, HP, Asus, Dell, and major EMS providers like Luxshare, Quanta, Foxconn, Compal, and Pegatron. The company also serves domestic new energy vehicle brands for automotive electronics applications. The main markets are the 3C consumer electronics industry and the new energy vehicle sector, with growing focus on AI-driven high-frequency electronics and lithium battery industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Kunshan, Huai'an, and Chongqing, and has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and factories in Vietnam, the United States, Thailand, and Taiwan. Sales and service offices are established in these regions to provide localized support, targeting East China, Southwest China, Southeast Asia, and North America markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Long Young operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics materials supply chain, producing specialized electromagnetic shielding materials, insulation and thermal management materials, and copper foil substrates. It integrates vertically by controlling upstream material processing (e.g., vacuum sputtering and plating) and downstream finishing processes (e.g., die-cutting), enabling customized product development and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven innovation focusing on expanding product categories and applications, especially in electromagnetic shielding and composite copper foil materials. R&D efforts target high-performance materials for AI electronics, 5G, and new energy vehicles, including development of high thermal conductivity materials, conductive foams with welding capabilities, and environmentally friendly shielding materials. It aims to break foreign technology monopolies in copper foil and enhance domestic substitution capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of manufactured products, including electromagnetic shielding materials, insulation materials, thermal management materials, and copper foil products. The company operates on a make-to-order basis with some demand forecasting, selling mainly through direct sales channels to large OEMs and EMS providers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Long Young is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and a leading domestic provider of high-performance EMI shielding materials. It holds a strong position in the domestic market with a reputable brand and stable relationships with top-tier global consumer electronics manufacturers. The company is expanding its footprint in new energy vehicle materials and copper foil sectors to compete with international suppliers and aims to enhance its market share through technological innovation and global expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 288 million, an 8.51% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 82.2 million, a 15.02% decrease. Total assets stood at about RMB 2.31 billion, showing slight growth. The company has steadily increased R&D investment, accounting for about 8.78% of revenue, and is expanding fixed assets with new production facilities in Vietnam and Thailand. Despite profit pressure from industry competition and investment costs, the company maintains a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Long Young emphasizes high-quality, high-performance electromagnetic shielding and copper foil materials with advanced manufacturing technologies that enhance shielding effectiveness, precision, and production efficiency. Its vertical integration allows for consistent raw material quality and rapid customization to meet stringent client requirements. The company’s products support cutting-edge applications in consumer electronics and new energy vehicles, offering solutions that address electromagnetic interference, thermal management, and insulation needs, thereby enabling clients to achieve superior device performance and reliability.
